verdict.rationale: AMD's product page does publish structured spec-sheet fields: ECC support (with a motherboard caveat), NVMe boot/RAID modes, supported OSes, 16 cores/32 threads, and a footnoted 208MB cache figure. Most of the story's named specs are absent from the evidence, and much of the surrounding content is marketing language. Missing for 10: published base/boost clocks, TDP/power figures, supported memory speeds/types, AI TOPS figures, and stated test conditions or methodology behind the claims.
